channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: Fix the potholes or fight the power? That's the choice facing California's next governor
item.description: Columnists Mark Z. Barabak and Anita Chabria agree the California race for governor isn't raising any roofs. But someone's going to win. Should they focus on the state's needs or battling Trump?

item.title: Ilia Malinin powers U.S. to Olympic gold in team figure skating competition
item.description: Despite a mistake, Ilia Malinin still wins the men's free skate to help lift the U.S. to gold in the figure skating team competition for the second straight Olympics.

item.title: Trump, California and the multi-front war over the next election
item.description: Local elections administrators across California say they have been preparing for once unthinkable threats to the midterms, from their own federal government.

item.title: How did those Bad Bunny-themed, anti-ICE towels get into the Super Bowl?
item.description: Before the game, activists clandestinely distributed 15,000 of them to fans entering Levi’s Stadium for the Super Bowl, seeding grassroots support toward a performer who spoke up for Latinos and immigrants at the Grammy Awards last week.

item.title: Bad Bunny brings Puerto Rico to the Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: The Puerto Rican superstar headlined music's biggest stage Sunday at Levi's Stadium in Santa Clara.

item.title: Here's who filed to run in L.A.'s city election
item.description: Candidates arrived at the City Clerk’s Office last week to file paperwork to run for city attorney, city controller, eight City Council seats and two L.A. Unified school board seats.

item.title: Who abducted Nancy Guthrie? A week after abduction, few answers as search grows more desperate
item.description: A week after Nancy Guthrie was abducted from her Tucson home, investigators spent the weekend searching at least two residences as more details emerged about a ransom note.

item.title: Bad Bunny fit in an actual wedding, with cake, in Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: A real couple said “I do” at the Super Bowl Halftime Show — and Bad Bunny and Lady Gaga were there to witness the holy matrimony.

item.title: Seahawks show their 'Dark Side' on defense and crush Patriots in Super Bowl LX
item.description: Behind a stifling defensive effort that had been their hallmark all season, the Seattle Seahawks defeat the New England Patriots 29-13 in Super Bowl LX.
